title: ROM ledger review: hiding and binding accounting, corrected parameter freeze

resources.Q_meaning: live RO queries inside ONE experiment: (1+J+3N) executions x q_A, plus 3J simulator commitments and 6N final-phase evaluations (Lemma T.2). Identical to (S.2).

counting_rule.hiding: sum_j Delta_H(D_j) <= J * min{1, 2*Q/2^rho} + J*(Q+2)/2^h  (Lemma T.1)
counting_rule.why_not_q_A: The RO is one fixed function for the whole experiment; every rewound execution issues up to q_A fresh queries against the same hidden salt, so the live count is the number of executions times q_A, not q_A.

rejected_wp1_tightenings.consequence: rho must rise 320 -> 384; the h=448 floor is withdrawn

ledger.acceptance: non_core <= 2^-149.5 proved exactly as non_core^2 * 2^299 <= 1 in Fractions
ledger.target: total <= 2^-128 proved exactly. Margin: total sits 7.9999 bits below 2^-128 (Assumption F dominates; erratum 2026-10-30: the total is 0.000105 bits ABOVE 2^-136, so the margin is 8 - 0.000105, not 8.0001); the non-FCSD sum alone sits 21.7487 bits below.

sensitivity.choice_note: 48-byte salt and 64-byte digest are primitive-aligned and keep ~32 extra bits below the knowledge term; 360/480 pass with almost no slack.

decisions.D3_prime: h=512 frozen; the WP1 'h=448 acceptable' floor is withdrawn because binom(Q,2)/2^448 = 2^-120.34 crosses 2^-128
decisions.D4_prime: rho=384, superseding WP1's rho=320; the q_A-only salt-guess count that justified 320 is invalid
decisions.D11: Ledger terms are priced by the number of experiment executions (R), not by per-branch caps, whenever the ROM is a single fixed function
decisions.D12: The private-placeholder variant (which would restore rho=320) is recorded as WP2-ledger section 5 but NOT adopted; it needs a separate min-entropy lemma and does not hold at n=640 where |S_C| < p^k

diagnostics.upper_bound_meaning: maximum of the multinomial over ALL compositions (coordinates spread evenly over the 251 field values); not the value of a usable composition
diagnostics.n640_note: the three published n=640 compositions have log2|S_C| in [2147.29, 2408.04] < log2 p^k = 2550.89, i.e. the witness is essentially determined by (H,s) there
diagnostics.do_not_write: must not claim that at n=1024 the witness is not determined by (H,s)

communication_impact.accounting: 3 commitments + 1 challenge byte + 2 opened salts, the same formula Ch.6 uses for 161 B
communication_impact.vs_wp1_rho320: salt delta only: 2 x 8 = 16 B/round; the digest delta 3 x 16 = 48 B is the rest
communication_impact.response_leg: deferred to WP5; depends on the sigma encoding

gates.WP2: DONE (with second-pass audit) - both WP1 tightenings disproved, correct bounds proved, rho/h re-frozen, non_core 2^-149.749 <= 2^-149.5; four wording defects repaired, no number changed
gates.WP3: open: freeze C at n=1024; G2 ISD/restricted-ball/union coverage; price or list gaps
gates.WP4: open: integrate proof; price T_B <= 2^166 with Q as the experiment-local count
gates.WP5: open: sizes and re-measurement at n=1024, N=256, h=512, rho=384
gates.WP6: open: paper integration; equation (4.2) still has the same shape, only the rho value and the ledger numbers change

hidden_salt_count.source: Table 3.1: challenge b opens salts (1,2), (1,3) or (2,3) of the three drawn per attempt, so exactly one commitment is never opened
hidden_salt_count.why_the_J_prefactor_is_legitimate: each hybrid experiment re-draws its own rho* and re-runs A up to R times, so hybrid j is billed from its own live-query budget Q; the J hybrids do not share one budget and cannot telescope to 2Q/2^rho

confirmed: Q as the experiment-level live query count (matches PROOF.md R.9)
hiding sum J*2Q/2^rho including the J prefactor
binding binom(Q,2)/2^h with no J prefactor (PROOF.md: E_bad is one whole event)
rejected_doubts_raised_in_the_audit: suspicion A: the J prefactor double-counts a shared query budget - FALSE, because rho* is redrawn per hybrid experiment and each experiment carries its own R executions
suspicion B: three salts per attempt must be hidden, giving 3J - FALSE for the ledger, Table 3.1 leaves exactly one unopened; and the 3J worst case leaves the sum unchanged at 2^-149.748731
wording_fixed: total margin over 2^-128 is 7.9999 bits, not 21.75 (21.7487 is the non-FCSD sum's own margin; erratum 2026-10-30: this line originally said 8.0001, which is the total's excess over 2^-136, not its margin under 2^-128)
the 7571.7-bit figure is an upper bound over all compositions, not the n=1024 composition value; multiplicity sign is undetermined before WP3
communication: security overhead is 289 B/round against the measured 161 B (+128 B/round, +32 KiB per session), not only +16 B
WP2_LEDGER.md header and section 9 said 29 checks; the script now runs 55, three of which are definitional identity guards for R and Q
